metadata.description: Deployment scenario.
Azure region for all resources.
Short region code used in resource names (e.g. wcus, eus).
Short prefix for resource names. 2-8 lowercase alphanumerics.
Hub VNet CIDR (must be a /23 to fit firewall + gateway + default + mgmt subnets).
Spoke VNet CIDR.
On-premises CIDRs. Required for vpn/full scenarios (used by VPN local network gateways and route tables).
Log Analytics workspace retention in days.
Base tags applied to all resources.
Enable a subscription-scoped monthly budget with email alerts. Free.
Monthly budget amount (USD or subscription billing currency).
Percent-of-budget thresholds for Actual-spend alerts.
Email recipients for budget alerts. Required when budgetEnabled = true.
Availability zones for zonal resources (e.g. NAT PIP). Pass [] in regions without AZ support.
NAT Gateway resource ID. Pass empty string to skip NAT association.

subnets.name: snet-workload
subnets.properties: [union(createObject('addressPrefix', parameters('workloadSubnetCidr')), if(variables('useNat'), createObject('natGateway', createObject('id', parameters('natGatewayId'))), createObject()))]

metadata.description: Availability zones for the firewall and its PIPs. Pass [] in regions without AZ support.
Availability zones for the VPN gateway PIP. Pass [] in regions without AZ support. The gateway SKU itself remains *AZ regardless (Azure requirement as of May 2026).
Short suffix used in the budget name (e.g. contoso-wcus).
Monthly budget amount in the subscription billing currency.
Percent-of-budget thresholds for Actual-spend alerts.
Email recipients for budget alerts. At least one required.
Optional list of resource group names to scope the budget to. Empty => entire subscription.
First-of-month start date for the budget time period (YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00Z).

properties.notifications: [union(toObject(parameters('thresholds'), lambda('t', format('Actual_GreaterThan_{0}_Percent', lambdaVariables('t'))), lambda('t', createObject('enabled', true(), 'operator', 'GreaterThan', 'threshold', lambdaVariables('t'), 'thresholdType', 'Actual', 'contactEmails', parameters('alertEmails')))), createObject('Forecasted_GreaterThan_100_Percent', createObject('enabled', true(), 'operator', 'GreaterThan', 'threshold', 100, 'thresholdType', 'Forecasted', 'contactEmails', parameters('alertEmails'))))]
